premises.text: Charcoal, firewood, and kerosene cooking create deadly indoor air pollution for Nigerian households
premises.evidence_span: 100,000 Nigerians die every year as a result of this act

premises.text: Many households also lack electricity access
Power stove is affordable, smokeless, cooks much faster, and generates electricity via a proprietary heat circuit
premises.evidence_span: proprietary circuit in-built that converts the excess heat while you cook to be able to generate electricity

premises.text: Good Life pellets from waste are far cheaper than charcoal, smokeless, and cook faster
premises.evidence_span: burns without smoke, so we are removing indoor air pollution

premises.text: Go-to-market uses cooperatives, MFIs, and informal fuel vendors without destroying their margins
premises.evidence_span: We are not destroying their market. We are giving them a better solution they can sell at a better price margin

premises.text: Unit economics include product sales plus after-sales under a 12-month guarantee, cheaper than rival stoves
premises.evidence_span: our stove is cheaper at $52 compared to $70

value.text: No family should suffer miscarriage or child pneumonia from cooking smoke
value.evidence_span: No woman should be able to have miscarriage because she's preparing meal for her family

secondary_value.evidence_span: in your kitchen, you can be generating electricity from your home

notes: Competitive price folded into commercial P6 with after-sales (§4.1(3)). Traction and prize ask excluded. Anti-template note: health need, product system, and vendor channel are separately revisable.
